facts.fact: NIMC's director-general says Nigeria's identity system enables real-time authentication across sectors and processes about 3.3 million verification requests daily.
NIMC's director-general says the identity ecosystem enables identity verification and real-time authentication across sectors, with about 3.3 million verification requests daily.

facts.fact: NIMC's director-general says Nigeria had reached 127 million unique identity records in its national identity database by December 2025, with about five million new enrolments a month.
NIMC's director-general says the NIN-SIM linkage policy, in force, drove digital identity adoption in telecommunications and strengthened identity verification nationwide.
NIMC's director-general says Nigeria processes about 3.3 million identity verification requests daily.

NGA.note: The document gives no account-ownership survey figure.

facts.fact: NIMC's director-general says over 206,000 refugees and internally displaced persons have been enrolled into the national identity database.
NIMC's director-general says refugees and internally displaced persons have been enrolled into the national identity database so that no one is left behind.
NIMC's director-general puts refugees and internally displaced persons enrolled in the national identity database at over 206,000.
